# Problem 1


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
z.test <- function(y, mu = 0, sigma = 1,
                   alternative = c('two.sided', 'less', 'greater'),
                   conf.level = 0.95) {
  
  alternative <- match.arg(alternative)
  message(paste('Number of missing values:', sum(is.na(y))))
  y_orig <- y
  y <- y[!is.na(y)]
  # Calculations here
  xbar <- mean(y)
  n <- length(y)
  se <- sigma / sqrt(n)
  z <- (xbar-mu)/se
  alpha <- 1-conf.level
  
  # Hypothesis tests
  if(alternative == "two.sided") {
    lcl <- xbar - qnorm(1-alpha/2)*se
    ucl <- xbar + qnorm(1-alpha/2)*se
    p.value <- 2*pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = F)
  } else if (alternative == 'less') {
    lcl <- -Inf
    ucl <- xbar + qnorm(1-alpha)*se
    p.value <- pnorm(z)
  } else if (alternative == 'greater') {
    lcl <- xbar - qnorm(1-alpha)*se
    ucl <- Inf
    p.value <- pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE)
  } else {
    stop("Invalid alternative provided")
  }
  
  
  # Organize results
  results <- list(
    data = y_orig,                                      # Original data
    sample_mean = xbar,                                # Mean of the data
    standard_error = se,                             # Standard error
    z = z,                                          # Test statistic
    parameters = list(mu = mu, sigma = sigma),     # Parameters        
    alternative = alternative,                     # The alternative hypothesis
    alpha = alpha,                                      # Significance level
    confidence_interval = list(lcl = lcl, ucl = ucl),    # Confidence interval
    p.value = p.value                                     # p-value of the test
    
  )
  
  # Output list of results
  return(results)
}
```

# Problem 5


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Remove missing values
y <- y[!is.na(y)]

# Calculate necessary values
n <- length(y)
xbar <- mean(y)
alpha <- 0.05
se <- sd(y)/sqrt(n)

test_statistic <- (xbar-4.19)/se
p_value <- pt(test_statistic, df = n-1, lower.tail = F)
ci <- xbar + c(-1,1)*qt(p=1-alpha, df=n-1)*se
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  test_statistic = test_statistic,
  p_value = p_value,
  lower_cl = ci[1],
  upper_cl = Inf
))
```
